Member email | Finch Lane Chess Circle
Subject: Two clock trials at Thursday's meetup

On Thursday, two tables will try a clock display that shows both players' remaining time in larger figures. The two trial tables will use the same game length as the other tables. Players can ask for the larger display without entering the tournament; the room stays open for friendly games.

One display also turns red when a player has two minutes left. The other keeps the same color throughout. Both displays show the same numerical time, and a volunteer will record which display each player starts with. We are asking about legibility, not whether the red signal changes playing speed, so try to report the two features [143] _____.

Some members can read large figures easily but find red figures hard to see under the hall lights. [144] _____ This will help us avoid treating a report about one color as a vote against large figures in general.

The larger display is not part of the official competition timetable. Anyone whose game runs past the volunteer's shift can leave feedback on the signup clipboard. The equipment is due back before the hall closes on Thursday. The comments will be read at nine the next morning, [145] _____ the equipment loan will have ended.

Finally, please state the table number on your comment. If you changed clocks in the middle of the game, give the clock numbers in the order you used them and say which clock your comment is about, because a table number alone [146] _____ which display you were reading.

會員郵件｜芬奇巷西洋棋社
主旨：星期四聚會的兩種時鐘試用

星期四有兩張棋桌會試用新款時鐘，以較大的數字顯示雙方剩餘時間。試用桌與其他棋桌的對局時間相同。棋友不用報名比賽就可申請大字顯示；場地仍開放自由對弈。

其中一款在任一棋友剩兩分鐘時會變成紅色，另一款全程顏色不變。兩款皆顯示同樣的時間數字，志工會記錄每位棋友起初使用哪一種。這次要了解是否易讀，不是要看紅色訊號會不會影響下棋速度，因此請將這兩種功能[143] _____回報。

有些會員容易看清大字，但在會場燈光下不容易看清紅色字。[144] _____ 這麼做能避免把對一種顏色的意見誤當成反對所有大字顯示。

大字顯示試用不屬於正式賽程。若對局超過志工值班時間，棋友可在報名夾板上留言。設備必須在星期四會場關閉前歸還。隔天早上九點會查看留言；[145] _____，設備的借用期限就已結束。

最後，請在留言中寫下桌號。如果對局中途換了時鐘，請按使用順序列出時鐘編號，並指出評論指的是哪一台，因為僅靠桌號[146] _____你當時看的是哪種顯示方式。
reviewPassage:
Member email | Finch Lane Chess Circle
Subject: Two clock trials at Thursday's meetup

On Thursday, two tables will try a clock display that shows both players' remaining time in larger figures. The two trial tables will use the same game length as the other tables. Players can ask for the larger display without entering the tournament; the room stays open for friendly games.

One display also turns red when a player has two minutes left. The other keeps the same color throughout. Both displays show the same numerical time, and a volunteer will record which display each player starts with. We are asking about legibility, not whether the red signal changes playing speed, so try to report the two features separately.

Some members can read large figures easily but find red figures hard to see under the hall lights. If the numbers are large enough but hard to see in red, say both things on the same comment. This will help us avoid treating a report about one color as a vote against large figures in general.

The larger display is not part of the official competition timetable. Anyone whose game runs past the volunteer's shift can leave feedback on the signup clipboard. The equipment is due back before the hall closes on Thursday. The comments will be read at nine the next morning, by which time the equipment loan will have ended.

Finally, please state the table number on your comment. If you changed clocks in the middle of the game, give the clock numbers in the order you used them and say which clock your comment is about, because a table number alone may not identify which display you were reading.
